## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Adds a runtime check and status reporting for Bandersnatch cryptographic bindings, indicating when native bindings are used or when a fallback/error is active.

* **Chores**
  * Upgrades native cryptography dependency and aligns crypto/WASM integration with the newer native bindings; no change to external behavior.

<sub>✏️ Tip: You can customize this high-level summary in your review settings.</sub>

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

This PR updates Bandersnatch-related code and tests across packages. It renames native/WASM binding functions from snake_case to camelCase, adds export function `checkNativeBindings(): Result<OK, string>` to detect native binding availability, adjusts `verifyHeaderSeals` to accept an additional `unsealedHeader` parameter, updates runtime logging to report native vs wasm status, replaces some deepStrictEqual assertions with string or deepEqual comparisons in tests, and bumps `@typeberry/native` versions in crypto and erasure-coding packages.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- PR `#599` — Modifies Bandersnatch native binding usage and name changes consistent with this PR's switch to camelCase and native checks.  
- PR `#649` — Updates `@typeberry/native` dependency versions as done here in multiple package.json files.  
- PR `#442` — Touches `packages/core/crypto/bandersnatch.ts` with related Bandersnatch API/type changes overlapping this PR.
